content: Able kaimegiz gize Ople detagerda, “Ma keriba owatur ikai aukakale obai.”

Ege Oplelut yabi daratagerda, “Ese waba owatur no kebile nagriwerteda able orwairorwair pe kebi mastad kep ikeredi, wa umele baker able au kelarkelar sipsip lu detagrare, “Ma mabu adem sipkem barbormur seplam a mabu bamordar ge gurge,” e ya wabi wadasrare.
Ese netat wabialam abra memegle wadawer, ei mara gedub wadirber; nerut kerkerge ei mara ebur wanaseserdlare, nade e taba dorgelam watakomer, nako ma abi detager, “Ma kei taba ge namri a lewer aro”?
Ma umerkak abi detager! Mai akai abi detager, “Ma kara lewer dirsir, a keubu ga akai mabu barsir, a kei tabakiamu taba kari sirnami nade yaka kara lewer arwer. Keuba ya ma mabra lewer ero.”
Ma umerkak ya able memegle eswao ikai nalu ge e ikeri nalu ge mama abi aukaise detagri e waikeri.

E able orwairge wabidoge ikeredi. Nade wa gair lu ikereda ge wabi detagerda wa waikerda, wage bakaretwa, “Ki no memegle uridli. Ki no able dorge ikerda ge kerbi detagerda ki waikerda.” Iesude 10 Lepera Le Nadgirda
Iesu digmer Ierusalemaem ege bakiamuda ge ikasereder Sameria ke irdireder a Galilaia ke irdireder.
Nade ge e ikasereder able utebem, ege 10 Lepera legize abi opdipita. Wige murizge tikweider
wige erer tabakri, “Iesuoi! Ople! Ma kerbi omarge dikerare!”
Nade ge Iesude yabi nardarda ege yabi daratagerda, “Wa bakiauare, wabu batomertare merkemem.” Wi nade ga gabge merkemem nakasir, wige bakeri sikak berda.
Netat yabialam tababu basmeri e akaida sikak baidari e takomeda tabakiamuda Iesuim aukaka aler Adi dispiri.
Able kimiar, e Samaria le dawer, tababu ikaida ge esigimeda Iesui opem a abi eswau ikaidari.
Iesude eudige abi ikaidari, “10 lepera le ge bakeri sikak berda; wader 9 pe nade uridli?
Nuluglam pe able suble no e takomedari Adi eswau waikai?”
Iesude eudige abi detagri, “Ma ekwei a bakiamu. Mama akaidari sikak baida ableglam mara owatur ikeredi.
